title: Atomic Habits — James Clear
description: Short lines from the book behind the "Small Enough to Stick" journey — worth having on hand long after the fourteen days are over.

quotes.text: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Habits are the compound interest of self-improvement.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: You should be far more concerned with your current trajectory than with your current results.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Success is the product of daily habits, not once-in-a-lifetime transformations.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: The most practical way to change who you are is to change what you do.
quotes.author: James Clear
